title: Personal Credit Cards: open billing disputes, resolution and rebilling of the temporary credit
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: billing dispute resolution and rebill

This policy covers what happens on a Personal Credit Cards account while a billing dispute is open and when it is resolved: the treatment of the disputed amount, the final credit, the reversal of related fees and interest, rebilling of the temporary credit, and the effect of a merchant credit.

## Policy clauses

1. While a dispute is open, the disputed amount is not counted toward the minimum payment, and no late fee or interest accrues on it.
2. When the dispute is resolved for the cardholder, the temporary credit becomes final with no new entry; if no temporary credit was posted, a final credit is posted on the dispute final ground.
3. On a resolution for the cardholder, fees and interest billed on the disputed charge are reversed.
4. A temporary credit may be rebilled only when the dispute status is resolved with the cardholder liable, or withdrawn, for the full temporary credit, with the rebill linked to the temporary credit.
5. A merchant credit for the same purchase that posts while the dispute is open resolves it for the cardholder up to the credit amount; the temporary credit is then rebilled for the part the merchant credit covered.

## Outcome table

| Outcome | Credit side | Rebill |
|---|---|---|
| Resolved for the cardholder, temporary credit posted | the temporary credit becomes final, no new entry | none |
| Resolved for the cardholder, no temporary credit posted | a final credit on the dispute final ground | none |
| Resolved with the cardholder liable | — | the full temporary credit |
| Withdrawn | — | the full temporary credit |
| Merchant credit for the same purchase posts while open | resolved for the cardholder up to the merchant credit | the part of the temporary credit the merchant credit covered |

The dispute status is read from the bank's dispute record.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical figures)

- Temporary credit 80.00 USD; a merchant credit of 30.00 USD for the same purchase posts while the dispute is open: the dispute is resolved for the cardholder up to 30.00 USD, and 30.00 USD of the temporary credit is rebilled.
- While a dispute over 80.00 USD is open, that 80.00 USD is left out of the minimum payment and accrues no interest or late fee.
